integrity.analytic_scope: All genuine finite convex Euclidean polygons, with independent uniform arclength samples on the whole boundary.
integrity.proof_dependencies: Two-side length integration; linear cone Jacobian; Euler sine product; strong Jensen inequality; tangential polygon sharpness construction.

scientific_limitations: The exact CDF identity is local and uses a polygon-dependent radius threshold; no global-in-radius law is proved.
The quantitative coefficient is sharp uniformly in the number of sides, but no fixed-side-count best variance coefficient is asserted.
A completely unindexed equivalent boundary-distance theorem cannot be ruled out by targeted searches.
Finite numerical checks are independent corroboration, not a replacement for mathematical proof.
title: Exact short-chord law and sharp angular rigidity for polygonal boundaries
